source.path: Sony Playstation 2/Devil May Cry 3_ Dante_s Awakening.pdf

evidence.Default/Left stick: pdf3 (printed 3) Default Game Controls: Left analog stick - Move Cursor, Walk/Run; pdf5 (printed 6): move the left analog stick slightly to walk, more strongly to run
evidence.Default/Right stick: pdf3 (printed 3): Right analog stick - Move camera; pdf5 (printed 7): use the right analog stick to move the camera around
evidence.Default/R3: pdf3 (printed 3): R3 Button - Reset camera behind character; pdf5 (printed 7): press in the right analog stick (R3 button) to reset the camera behind Dante
evidence.Default/Up: pdf3 (printed 3): Directional button - Move Cursor; Subscreen shortcuts: Up arrow Item Screen
evidence.Default/Right: pdf3 (printed 3): Subscreen shortcuts: Right arrow Map Screen
evidence.Default/Left: pdf3 (printed 3): Subscreen shortcuts: Left arrow File Screen
evidence.Default/Down: pdf3 (printed 3): Subscreen shortcuts: Down arrow Equip Screen
evidence.Default/Triangle: pdf3 (printed 3): Triangle Button - Close-range attack; Cancel; pdf5 (printed 7): press the Triangle button to use your sword or other close-range weapon
evidence.Default/Circle: pdf3 (printed 3): Circle Button - Style Move; Check; pdf5 (printed 6): press the Circle button to check it out; use the Circle button to perform unique moves particular to the chosen Style
evidence.Default/Square: pdf3 (printed 3): Square Button - Long-range attack; pdf5 (printed 7): press the Square button to use your gun or other long-range weapon
evidence.Default/Cross: pdf3 (printed 3): Cross Button - Jump/Dodge; Confirm; pdf5 (printed 6): press the Cross button to jump; pdf7 (printed 11) Air Hike: press the Cross button twice rapidly
evidence.Default/L1: pdf3 (printed 3): L1 Button - Devil Trigger; pdf5 (printed 7): press the L1 button to transform into a demon; press again to cancel
evidence.Default/L2: pdf3 (printed 3): L2 Button - Switch long-range weapon; pdf5 (printed 7): press the L2 button to cycle through them
evidence.Default/R1: pdf3 (printed 3): R1 Button - Lock-on target; pdf5 (printed 6): press and hold the R1 button to walk in a ready stance with Dante's guns out
evidence.Default/R2: pdf3 (printed 3): R2 Button - Switch close-range weapon; pdf5 (printed 7): press the R2 button to cycle through them
evidence.Default/R1+L3: pdf3 (printed 3): L3 Button - Change lock-on target (hold the R1 button, press in the L3 button); pdf5 (printed 6): press in the L3 button while holding the R1 button
evidence.Default/Left stick+R1+Triangle: pdf7 (printed 11) Rebellion Moves: High Time - hold the R1 button, press the Triangle button, and move the left analog stick opposite to the direction you're facing; Stinger - hold R1, press Triangle, and move the left analog stick in the direction you're facing
evidence.Default/Left stick+Circle: pdf7 (printed 11) Ebony & Ivory/Gunslinger Style: Twosome Time - press the left analog stick + the Circle button
